policies.text: If the country of citizenship of something is X, and the head of government of X is Y, then the head of government of the country of citizenship of that thing is Y.
If the country of citizenship of something is X, and the head of state of X is Y, then the head of state of the country of citizenship of that thing is Y.
If the employer of the author of something is X, and the headquarters location of X is Y, then the headquarters location of the employer of the author of that thing is Y.
If the work location of something is X, and the head of government of X is Y, then the head of government of the work location of that thing is Y.
If the employer of something is X, and the director / manager of X is Y, then the director / manager of the employer of that thing is Y.
